caption:
Three green months on demo. Two red weeks live. Same method, same setups, same hours.

Demo tested whether you can read a chart. Live tests whether you execute when every decision has a cost you can feel — and that cost is exactly what your wiring reacts to. Demo removed the only variable that breaks people.

Going back won't fix it: you'd re-pass the exam you already passed while the one you failed stays untaken.

Comment "MAP" for the 3T engine indicator.
